ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: High-contrast distribution characterized by a high-intensity white/light-gray base (>85% of surface area) with low-intensity black/dark-gray pixels concentrated at the perimeter and central axis.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Central vertical dark-intensity 'anchor' geometry at the peduncle junction; continuous dark-intensity band along the trailing edge boundary (3-7 pixel width); sparse distribution of discrete dark-pixel focal spots scattered across both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep acute V-shaped depression with a calculated angle of approximately 42 degrees; symmetric alignment with the peduncle axis.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, low-amplitude micro-serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary; distinct secondary indentations located approximately 15% and 30% from the central notch on the right lobe edge.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Trailing edge follows a slightly convex curve transitioning to sharp, tapered tips; leading edge exhibits a linear-to-convex sweep.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Localized dark-pixel clusters at the extreme distal tips of both lobes; potential localized scarring or barnacle attachment points at the left lobe terminal.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Three distinct parallel diagonal low-contrast linear markings on the medial region of the right lobe; singular horizontal linear disruption on the left inner lobe near the peduncle.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Serrated/irregular pigmentation at the peduncle base forming a 'staircase' pattern of alternating high and low intensity bands.
other_distinctive_markers: Distinctive high-contrast dark-spotting concentrated exclusively at the leading edge/tip junction of the right lobe.
